notes.title: A new game from the developer comes out in the summer!
notes.content:
This summer comes a new horror about the seizure of the earth by alien forces.
In order not to miss the release of the game, you need to click "Add to Wishlist":

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594340/Last_Village/

notes.title: Discount for Winter Sale 2020.
notes.content:
Happy New Year 2021!
Until December 31, 2020, the game Ghost Stories 2 will have a 40% discount.

notes.title: Ghost Stories 2 Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Today, 11.11.2020, the official release of the second part of the game about the haunted house took place.
You can buy the game now with a 10% discount.
